primary_route.name: uniform-right-basis-kernel-frames
steps: Finish native qualification and body review of the exact matrix right-orbit and Fourier covariance candidates.
Specialize the existing universal frame-cardinality theorem to ZMod 2 and the full domain/kernel vector spaces, including finrank and empty-frame cases.

Prove GL acts transitively on independent ordered s-frames by basis extension or the transpose/surjective-map transport. A bijection between restriction fibres then proves the last s columns of a uniform full basis have uniform frame distribution.
For frequency Y of rank i<=d=c+s, tail-zero after a right basis change is equivalent to its tail frame lying in ker(Matrix.toLin Y). Rank-nullity gives kernel dimension d-i.
Use the verified cardinality API to express that probability as frames(d-i,s)/frames(d,s); if i>c, no independent s-frame fits in the kernel, so the probability is zero.

Use exact Fourier covariance, rank preservation, actual append coefficient identities and Parseval. Reindex a double finite average to obtain post-level energy = this probability times full-level energy.
For i<=c, each positive factor ratio is <=2^(-i), giving probability <=2^(-i*s). Handle i=0, s=0 and dimension-zero products explicitly.
Transfer the stronger gain to the original weaker Spectral47 right-hand side using nonnegative full energy and nonnegative ambient error; retain every original parameter and guard.
